alerts.title: CLOSURE: KCC Performing Arts Center Bus Stop
alerts.text: Effective September 1st, 2026, the bus stop at the KCC Performing Arts Center will not be accessed through December 31, 2026, due to maintenance work at the entrance/exit.  The Kaumualii Hwy -Across KCC and Kaumualii Hwy - KCC stops will be serviced as normal.  We thank you for your patience.

alerts.title: Route 900/950 Temporary Suspension
alerts.text: In the aftermath of Hurricane Lowell, Routes 900 Anahola-Waimea and 950 Waimea-Anahola are temporarily suspended until further notice.  We thank you for your patience.
